title: Human review of 20 labeler comments for leakage and realism (S3)
description:
## Purpose

Have a person check the L2 comments for leakage and realism before any analyst sees them (stop S3).

## Scope

A human (owner or delegate) reads 20 generated comments, sampled with a fixed seed, against the hidden convention: does any quote or paraphrase the rule too closely, and do they read like a busy reviewer?

## Definition of done

Verdict recorded here as a comment (pass, or revise the prompt and regenerate). No analyst call uses the comments before a pass. Cost: $0. **Stop S3.**

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §2 (A human checks first), §6 step 7.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closed without doing the human read: the owner chose a simulated human consulting a hidden rubric and said development-phase ceremony is noise. A quick look at sample comments showed sensible terse reasons (sports/dry-work convention). The leakage-by-design caveat is recorded in the results.
